name: OBDForge
pitch: OBDForge is a GPL-3.0-or-later Android app for ELM327 and OBDLink adapters: live PIDs, DTC workflows, shop intake, and on-device AI — no Play Services, F-Droid compatible.
features: Live PID dashboard with persona modes
DTC read/clear, freeze-frame, and session history
Reproducible APK builds and F-Droid metadata
quick_start: Open Cursor Agent and type `/tour` or `/coach`.
usage: Use `/verify` before merge and `/ship` to publish. Active stack is Android only.
